payouts.description: Affiliate commissions by month. At the end of the month you close the period: commissions for completed trips are approved and the amount to pay each affiliate is calculated.

payouts.closeLater: The period can be closed once the month is over.
payouts.emptyClosable: No payouts yet. Close the period to calculate them.
payouts.confirmCloseDescription: Commissions for trips that took place are approved, and a payout is calculated for each affiliate. The money is not sent automatically: once you have paid, press “Mark as paid”.
payouts.reportDescription: Sales paid in {period} and their commissions.
payouts.noSales: No sales through affiliates this month.
payouts.notOver: The month is not over yet. You can close it from the 1st of next month.
